subject: English
title: English 3 (PECTAA, SNC 2020)
questions: Which word has the soft sound of 'c' (like 's')?
In 'city' the letter c sounds like s. In cat, cap and can it sounds like k.
Which word has the soft sound of 'g' (like 'j')?
In 'giant' the letter g sounds like j.
Which word begins with the consonant cluster 'sh'?
'Ship' begins with sh. Two letters joined to make one sound make a consonant cluster.
Which word ends with the consonant cluster 'st'?
'Dust' ends with st; stamp and stick begin with it.
Which of these is a proper noun?
A proper noun is the name of a particular person, place or thing and begins with a capital letter.
Which of these is a common noun?
A common noun names any person, place or thing and does not begin with a capital letter.
Opposites have totally different meanings: clean — dirty.
Adding 'un' to healthy gives its opposite, unhealthy.
How many syllables are there in 'activity' (ac-ti-vi-ty)?
ac-ti-vi-ty has four parts, so four syllables.
Which punctuation mark ends a sentence with a pause?
A full stop (.) ends a sentence.
Which word comes first in alphabetical (ABC) order?
'Activity' starts with a, which comes first in the alphabet.
In the speech 'First Day in Class III', what is the most important class rule?
The speech says the most important rule is to keep our classroom clean.
Which of these letters is a vowel?
The vowels are a, e, i, o and u. All other letters are consonants.
Which word has a long vowel sound?
In 'boat' the vowel says its own name (oa). Hit, bed and box have short vowel sounds.
Which word has a short vowel sound?
A vowel in the middle of a short word like 'cat' is usually short.
In the poem 'Golden Sun', the sun is called the life of all ______.
The poem says: 'You are the life of all things' — life on earth depends on the sun.
Which word is a conjunction (joining word)?
A conjunction joins words or sentences, like and, but, or, because.
Fill in the blank: 'Do you want to buy a shirt ___ a pair of shoes?'
'Or' is used to give a choice between two things.
Which pair of words are anagrams?
An anagram is made by rearranging the letters of another word: break → baker.
In 'The pencil is on the table', what is the subject?
The subject is what the sentence is about: the pencil. 'Is' is the verb.
How do we write 68 in words?
the rise and fall of the voice while speaking
Intonation is the rise and fall of our voice; yes/no questions end with a rising voice.
In 'My Happy Home', what is the name of the girl telling about her family?
The text begins: 'My name is Bano. I live in a small house.'
Bano has a white kitten as a pet.
According to the family rules, we should not accept eatables or gifts from:
Strangers are people we don't know; we must not accept gifts or eatables from them.
Which word is used with 'he, she and it'?
'Has' is used with he, she and it; 'have' is used with I, we, you and they.
What is the short form (contraction) of 'I have'?
What is the contraction of 'has not'?
Which of these is a feminine noun?
'Niece' is feminine; nephew is its masculine.
Which of these is a neuter noun (neither male nor female)?
A ship is not male or female, so it is neuter gender.
The female of a horse is a mare.
Which mark shows mood and emotion, as in 'Pakistan has won the match!'?
An exclamation mark (!) shows strong feelings.
Which companion said he had never seen anyone kinder to children than the Rasool ﷺ?
Hazrat Anas (RA) said: 'I have never seen anyone act more kindly towards children than Allah's Rasool.'
Who were the grandchildren of the Rasool ﷺ mentioned in the unit?
Hazrat Imam Hassan and Hazrat Imam Hussain
Hazrat Abu Bakr and Hazrat Umar
The unit tells how the Rasool ﷺ picked up Hazrat Imam Hassan and Hazrat Imam Hussain when they fell.
To whom did the Rasool ﷺ give the first fruit of the season?
When the first fruit of the season was brought, he gave it to the youngest child present.
In battles, the Rasool ﷺ ordered his followers:
not to kill women and children
to leave children alone in the desert
Even in battle he commanded that women and children must not be killed.
A Naat is a poem that specially praises Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ.
Two letters joined to give one sound, like 'ch' in chair, are called a:
A digraph is one sound made by two letters; a trigraph is made by three letters (tch in watch).
Which word ends with the trigraph 'tch'?
'Catch' ends with t-c-h, three letters that make one sound.
Which word is an adjective in 'My father bought a new house'?
An adjective describes a noun: 'new' describes the house.
Which word is a possessive adjective?
'Our' shows who owns something, as in 'Our house is new'.
Which sentence is in the present continuous tense?
The present continuous (is/am/are + -ing) shows an action going on now.
Fill in the conjunction: 'He was holding an umbrella ___ it was raining.'
He held the umbrella for a reason — because it was raining.
The three basic elements of a story are:
full stop, comma and question mark
Every story has a beginning, a middle and an end, along with characters, place and time.
Where should we cross the road?
The black and white lines of the zebra crossing are the safe place to cross.
Before crossing the road, after standing at the side we first look to the:
Step 1: stand at the side and look to your right; step 2: look left; step 3: look right again and cross.
What does the red traffic light tell us?
The poem 'Traffic Lights' says: red light — stop, yellow — start (get ready), green — go.
What does the green traffic light tell us?
When should we get down from a school van?
Keep sitting till the bus or van stops; never get down from a moving vehicle.
Where should we walk on a busy road?
in the middle of the road
on the zebra crossing all the time
Walk on the footpath to stay safe.
What is the contraction of 'does not'?
With he/she/it we use doesn't + the present form of the verb (play).
Which of these is an uncountable noun?
We can count glasses, but we cannot count water.
Which of these is a countable noun?
Bicycles can be counted: one bicycle, two bicycles.
'Can' shows ability. Which sentence shows inability?
'Cannot' (can't) is used for things we are not able to do.
Which word means 'a machine with wheels and an engine'?
Cars, buses and trucks are vehicles.
In 'The Day of Silence', what problem did Rizwan have since birth?
Rizwan could not hear since birth, so he learnt sign language.
How did Rizwan communicate with others?
A doctor advised his parents to help him learn sign language.
People treated him like a little child
His parents and the villagers treated him as a little child, which made him feel unhappy.
Who had the idea of 'The Day of Silence'?
His friend Mumtaz asked his father to arrange a festival for people who could not hear.
On 'The Day of Silence', everyone in the town wore:
Everyone put earplugs in their ears for the whole day.
What lesson does the story teach?
Everyone has a special talent and should be given an equal chance
Games are a waste of time
We should not go to festivals
The story ends: everyone has some special talent and should be given an equal chance.
Nouns ending in x, s, sh or ch add 'es': box → boxes.
Most nouns just add 's': visitor → visitors.
Fill in the article: 'I saw ___ elephant yesterday.'
'An' is used before words beginning with a vowel sound (e, a, i, o, u).
Fill in the article: 'Ahmad is ___ best boy of my class.'
'The' is used for a particular one, including with 'best'.
Which needs 'an' because of a silent 'h'?
We say 'an hour' because the h in hour is silent.
In 'lamb' the b is not spoken.
Which of these is an outdoor game?
Games played in the playground like cricket, hockey and kabaddi are outdoor games.
Which of these is an indoor game?
Ludo is played indoors with family members.
According to the text, sports help children to:
become leaders and learn the value of time
The text says sports help children become leaders and teach them the value of time.
Which activity gives energy and strength to the body, as the text says?
Skipping rope is popular and gives energy and strength to the body.
Which word begins with the consonant cluster 'cr'?
Crown begins with cr; spider, space and special begin with sp.
Which word begins with the consonant cluster 'sp'?
Which of these is an action (doing) verb?
Action verbs show what we can do: jump, run, write.
Homophones sound the same but have different meanings. Choose the pair of homophones.
Here and hear sound the same but are spelt differently and mean different things.
Fill in: 'I can ___ the birds singing.'
'Hear' means to listen with the ears; 'here' means this place.
Your siblings are your brothers and sisters.
Which of these is a natural resource?
Air, water, land, sunlight, minerals, plants and animals are gifts of nature (natural resources).
Why will there be a shortage of water in future, according to the text?
The text warns that if we continue wasting water there will be an acute shortage.
How can we save water while brushing our teeth?
Wash the car with a hose
Turn off the tap while brushing teeth and washing hands.
Which is a good way to save electricity?
Leave fans on in empty rooms
Keep the TV on all night
Switch off extra lights and fans and use natural light.
Paper is made of wood, so using less paper means fewer trees are cut down.
Which form of energy from the sun can help us save electricity?
Solar energy is another service that can help us save electricity.
Choose the possessive pronoun: 'The bag belongs to Hina. It is ___.'
'Hers' is a possessive pronoun that shows the bag is Hina's.
'My parents and I live in this house. The house is ___.'
'Ours' shows that the house belongs to us.
In 'Arif played a match. He enjoyed it.', which word is a pronoun used for Arif?
A pronoun is used in place of a noun: 'He' stands for Arif.
Which word shows where the cat is: 'A cat is under the table'?
'Under' is a preposition: it shows the position of the cat.
'To make unclean' is the meaning of:
To pollute means to make air, water or land dirty.
the way people live, think and behave in a society
The unit defines culture as the way people live, think and behave in a society.
According to the text, Pakistanis are known as:
hospitable people who take care of guests
Pakistanis are hospitable people; we always take care of our guests.
Eid-ul-Fitr and Eid-ul-Adha are religious festivals.
Pakistan Day is celebrated to commemorate the Lahore Resolution.
Which polite expression do we use to thank someone?
'Thank you' shows gratitude; 'You're welcome' is the reply.
Which sentence is in the simple past tense?
'Taught' is the past form of teach.
Which sentence is in the simple future tense?
We use will/shall with the first form of the verb for the future.
'We went to our village last Sunday' is in the:
Fill in: 'Yesterday, they ___ playing cricket in the park.'
With 'they' in the past we use 'were'.
Which word has a short 'e' sound?
'Pet' has a short e sound; bee, see and tree have a long e.
In the poem 'Our Family Picnic', what spoiled the picnic?
It got rainy and dark, things blew away, mosquitoes bit them and bees attacked them.
Which word begins with the blend 'str'?
'Street' begins with the blend str; 'quiet' and 'quick' begin with qu.
A compass rose on a map is used to show:
A compass rose tells directions such as North, South, East and West.
Choose the correct sentence for asking permission.
Prepositions like with, in, over, from, about show the relation of a noun to other words.
Which shows possession with an apostrophe correctly?
We add 's to show that something belongs to someone: Majid's car.
What is the contraction of 'I will'?
What is the contraction of 'who is'?
Choose the correct word: '___ you swim?' (asking about ability)
'May' is used for something that is possible in the future.
In the story, on whom did the wizard first use his new spell for perfect teeth?
The wizard decided to use the spell on one of his toads.
What did the toad love to eat after getting perfect teeth?
The toad said he preferred eating candies, and he ate many sweets.
What happened to the toad's teeth in the end?
A tooth started decaying, the decay spread, and his teeth fell out.
What lesson does the story of the toad teach?
Look after your teeth and don't eat too many sweets
Eat as many sweets as you like
The wizard told the toad: look after your teeth, don't eat so many sweets.
In knife the k is silent.
In write the w is silent.
How many syllables are there in 'banana' (ba-na-na)?
After t or d, -ed sounds like /id/: wanted, needed.
Which question word asks about a place?
Which question word asks about a person?
A dictionary lists words and their meanings in:
A dictionary is always in alphabetical order.
Fill in: 'Wash your hands ___ eating food.'
We wash our hands before eating to keep germs away.
